problemStatement.plain: Erdős #268 asks: can every point in a neighborhood of some $d$-tuple be expressed as a $d$-tuple of harmonic subseries sums? The gallery proof handles $d=1$ directly, but for $d \geq 2$ the path-connectedness argument (needed to show the interior is non-empty via the intermediate value theorem approach) is left as a sorry.
